title: Fixed Twin-Guide Round-Platform Speed Bag Stand
description: One newly authored complete static speed-bag platform stand. Two long grounded runners and low triangular braces carry two complete tall polygonal guide posts and top/bottom cross ties. One fixed bridge has two real full-length matched-bore sleeves around those guides, rear lock-knob appearances, two forward cantilever rails and upper diagonal braces supporting a complete thick circular wooden rebound platform. A short actual underside boss and fixed connector enter one whole softly shouldered pear-shaped bag directly below the platform. This is not the previous long four-strap cylindrical heavy bag hung from a single tall eye, nor a cable/weight pulldown tower: the whole guided deck carriage and short direct bag-to-platform relationship are newly authored. All geometry new; only mature generic helpers reused. Four opaque constant untextured PBR roles, native metres and Z up, whole horizontally bounds-centred ground origin. One complete prop, zero scenes. Static fixed appearance only: no adjustment travel, sliding mechanism, hinge or swivel simulation, rebound behavior, punching response, exercise suitability, load rating, manufacture or equipment-safety claim. No athlete, text, textures or surrounding room.
